pages.title: Grand Unified Core
pages.text: At sufficiently high energy, the electromagnetic, weak and strong couplings run together and meet. Grand unified theories predict magnetic monopoles and proton decay as a consequence. The core is bright and calm, three forces resting in a single symmetry.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Running the Standard Model's couplings upward with superpartners included, I saw them converge. In the Tesseract Assembler, a monopole and a quantum string held the high-energy state long enough to crystallise it.

Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Grand Unification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Eschaton Core, Standard Model Singularity, Theory of Everything, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma.
